snippet.title: Catch the Octopus 🐙 Launching October 16, 2026 on Steam!
snippet.description:
🐙 Can you find the hidden octopus?

Welcome to Catch the Octopus, a multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you can transform into objects, hide from the Seeker, or become the Seeker and find the hidden Octopuses! 🔨

🎮 Play with 2–24 players!
Transform, hide, trick your friends, and enjoy chaotic hide-and-seek moments together!

🚀 Launching October 16, 2026 on Steam!

💜 Add Catch the Octopus to your Steam wishlist and get ready to play!

🔗 Steam Store:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4952840/Catch_the_Octopus/


#CatchTheOctopus #IndieGame #SteamGames #PropHunt #Multiplayer #HideAndSeek
